description: We are "Be Like Astronaut", competing in NASA Space Apps 2026 (Cairo) on Challenge #3: "Build a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer".
summary:
The Little Galaxy Explorer is an interactive educational space adventure designed to introduce young explorers to space science through gameplay. Players explore different space environments, complete challenges and puzzles, collect resources, and learn about scientific concepts related to Mars exploration and human space missions.

The project combines entertainment and education through interactive worlds, NASA-inspired science activities, and mission-based challenges. It aims to make complex space topics easier and more engaging for younger audiences while encouraging curiosity, problem-solving, teamwork, and scientific thinking.

By connecting game mechanics with real space exploration concepts, the project provides an accessible and engaging way for children to discover the challenges of exploring and living in space.
details: The Little Galaxy Explorer is an interactive educational space adventure that introduces children to space exploration through a series of game worlds, missions, puzzles, and challenges. Players can choose between astronaut characters and explore different environments, including a Martian storm valley, a plant oasis, an orbital ice station, a magnetic crystal belt, and a galactic core castle. Throughout the game, players collect crystals and stars, rescue characters, overcome obstacles, and complete challenges. The project also includes an interactive NASA Science Lab that presents simplified scientific information about real space exploration technologies and discoveries. Topics include oxygen production from the Martian atmosphere, power generation during dust storms, water ice on Mars, plant growth in controlled environments, and radiation protection for astronauts. The game aims to make space science more accessible and enjoyable for younger audiences. It encourages curiosity, critical thinking, problem-solving, and learning through interaction rather than passive reading. The project was developed using web technologies, including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with interactive game elements and browser-based functionality. The team focused on combining educational value with an engaging gameplay experience, making scientific concepts understandable through exploration and challenges. The creative approach is to transform real space science concepts into an interactive adventure that encourages young players to explore, experiment, and learn about the challenges of space missions.
